name: yanlings_harbinger_finds_mu_yanling_in_library
notes: Pf8fa4a9835 G4. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Mu Yanling, Celestial Wind, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' Seat 0 casts Yanling's Harbinger ({3}{U}{U}, spent exactly), accepts the may and searches the library only (option 1): Mu Yanling, Celestial Wind goes to hand; a decoy planeswalker named Mu Yanling, Sky Dancer stays in the (shuffled) library.
